mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates aggressive monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.5% signals persistent labor market weakness, suppressing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and earnings growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline below 100 fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of late-cycle expansion periods.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating price pressures, triggering monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Residential housing starts above 950 thousand units indicate strong construction activity and consumer confidence, driving corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 950 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in payrolls (PAYEMS) signal labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of falling UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to produce positive returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 indicates manufacturing slowdown, reducing corporate output and earnings growth, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.
